selection.reason: CPU-only host; official Chinese-capable instruct model; native GGUF; Apache-2.0; strict JSON grammar support through llama.cpp
selection.rejected_larger_default: A 7B-class Q8 model would consume materially more RAM, disk and latency without dev evidence justifying it.

hardware.gpu_probe: nvidia-smi returned NVML unknown error; CPU-only run

fine_tuning.decision: Prompt repair plus constrained decoding removed format failures. The dev split contains only wealth-comparison clusters, so it did not provide broad evidence that LoRA would improve general routing without overfitting. The frozen test was evaluated once and exposed weak local generalization; it must not now be reused for training decisions. Preserve the untuned baseline and create a stratified v1.1 dev/test design before training.
